name: Kiara Ketchner
source:
Kiara Ketchner is the only daughter of [url=https://vndb.org/c167530]Karmen Ketchner[/url]. She's had to grow up without a father with only her mother for support. Kiara isn't the best at opening up her feelings to others and keeps a lot in reserve, but she seems to enjoy [url=https://vndb.org/c167447]Byron[/url]'s company at the very least.
